dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: Welcome, welcome to this fair ocean of words!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have a look, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: Take your time. Personally, I'd recommend a thriller!

dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: You can call me the... temporary owner of this little establishment.

dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: I say "temporary," for it is my dream to join The Steambird!

dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: I work hard every day, honing my scripts and accumulating rhetoric to constantly improve my understanding of the art of language!

dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: One day, I'll report all I've seen, and my astounding literary skills will spill across the headlines!

dialogues.speaker: Hubel
dialogues.text: We refresh our lineup often, so come back again soon!
